purpose: Define cross-division compliance requirements for all municipal domains, mapping standards, documentation, kernels, and oversight pathways.

governance_and_authority.description: Compliance requirements governing municipal authority, decision-making, and lawful operations.
requirements: Documentation of all decisions in immutable audit trails
Constitutional alignment review via Ethics Kernel

civil_rights_and_wellbeing.description: Standards ensuring protection of civilian rights, dignity, and wellbeing.
requirements: Rights-impact assessment for all high-risk actions
Disproportionate impact monitoring via Telemetry Kernel

documentation_and_records.description: Compliance requirements for municipal documentation, audit trails, and public transparency.
requirements: Public transparency sync for non-sensitive data

telemetry_and_intelligence.description: Standards for telemetry-driven pattern detection, risk scoring, and anomaly identification.

municipal_operations.description: Compliance requirements for infrastructure, logistics, and operational continuity.

public_safety_and_community_support.description: Standards for non-punitive, trauma-informed community safety operations.

citizen_advocacy_and_ombudsman.description: Compliance requirements for civilian complaint handling, advocacy, and rights protection.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Actor verification, authority classification, timestamp authority.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Anomaly detection, pattern analysis, risk scoring.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Rights-impact evaluation, constitutional safeguards, harm prevention.

compliance_escalation_paths.critical: Immediate escalation to Ethics Division and Civic Integrity Division.
compliance_escalation_paths.high: Review by Telemetry Division and Accountability Division.
compliance_escalation_paths.medium: Corrective action directive issued to responsible municipal department.
